title: TypeScript 6 module resolution: bundler, node16/nodenext, and package exports

curriculum.learner_outcome: Choose a module resolution mode and match it to the runtime and the package exports map.
curriculum.production_scenario: A package resolves in the bundler but fails at runtime because the exports map lacks a types condition.
misconceptions: The compiler resolving an import proves nothing about the runtime resolving it.
curriculum.evidence: A resolution trace from --traceResolution for one failing import.
curriculum.artifact: A resolution configuration with an exports-map test for consumers.

title: Project references and incremental build graphs

curriculum.learner_outcome: Structure a multi-project build with references so builds are incremental and ordered.
curriculum.production_scenario: A monorepo type-checks everything on every change and CI takes twenty minutes.
misconceptions: References are not just for speed; they also stop one project from reaching another's unbuilt sources.
curriculum.evidence: A --verbose build log showing skipped up-to-date projects.
curriculum.artifact: A references graph for one workspace with measured rebuild times.

title: Control-flow analysis and definite assignment

curriculum.learner_outcome: Explain definite assignment and how control flow changes a variable's type across branches.
curriculum.production_scenario: A variable is used before assignment in one branch and the compiler reports it only after enabling strict.
misconceptions: Narrowing is per flow node; an assignment anywhere in the flow resets it.
curriculum.evidence: A file showing narrowed types before and after an intervening assignment.
curriculum.artifact: A control-flow guideline with examples of resets and aliases.

title: Branded types, opaque aliases, and nominal patterns

curriculum.learner_outcome: Create nominal-like types with brands so two structurally identical values cannot be confused.
mechanisms: constructor functions as the only source
curriculum.production_scenario: A user id and an order id are both strings and a lookup swaps them silently.
misconceptions: A brand is a compile-time discipline; it adds no runtime check.
curriculum.evidence: A test showing the swapped ids rejected by the compiler.
curriculum.artifact: A branded id module used at the domain boundaries.

title: The satisfies operator and type preservation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Check a value against a type with satisfies while keeping its inferred, narrower type.
curriculum.production_scenario: A configuration object annotated with its type loses literal keys and autocomplete downstream.
misconceptions: satisfies checks a value; an as assertion overrides the checker.
curriculum.evidence: Hover output comparing annotation, assertion and satisfies for the same object.
curriculum.artifact: A configuration module using satisfies with preserved literals.

title: Downlevel emit, helpers, and polyfill boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Predict what downlevel emit generates for a target and where helpers and polyfills are needed.
curriculum.production_scenario: A build for older browsers ships async generators that crash without a regenerator runtime.
misconceptions: Setting lib makes a type available; it does not add the runtime.
curriculum.evidence: Emitted output for one file at two targets with helper imports highlighted.
curriculum.artifact: A target and polyfill policy with a verified output sample.

title: Standard decorators vs legacy experimental decorators and metadata emit

curriculum.learner_outcome: Distinguish standard decorators from legacy experimental decorators and their metadata behavior.
curriculum.production_scenario: A dependency-injection library breaks after standard decorators become the default.
misconceptions: The two decorator systems are different features with different signatures, not versions of one.
curriculum.evidence: A file compiled under both flags with the resulting emit compared.
curriculum.artifact: A decorator migration note for one framework integration.

title: tsserver performance and solution-style builds

curriculum.learner_outcome: Diagnose slow type checking and editor latency and restructure builds to fix it.
curriculum.production_scenario: Hovering a component takes seconds because one utility type instantiates millions of times.
misconceptions: Editor slowness is usually a few expensive types, not the size of the codebase.
curriculum.evidence: A --extendedDiagnostics and --generateTrace report identifying the hot type.
curriculum.artifact: A performance fix with before and after diagnostics.

title: Type erasure limits and runtime type contracts

curriculum.learner_outcome: Explain what erasure removes and design runtime contracts where types cannot help.
curriculum.production_scenario: A JSON payload typed as User crashes because a field is missing at runtime.
misconceptions: A type annotation on parsed data is a claim, not a check.
curriculum.evidence: A demonstration of erased types in emitted JavaScript next to the runtime failure.
curriculum.artifact: A boundary contract with runtime checks where types are erased.

title: Typing generic, polymorphic component props

curriculum.learner_outcome: Type generic and polymorphic component props without losing inference at call sites.
curriculum.production_scenario: A polymorphic button loses its element props once the as prop is generic.
misconceptions: Generic props must be inferred from the call site; explicit annotations at the definition do not help callers.
curriculum.evidence: Hover output at a call site showing inferred props for two element types.
curriculum.artifact: A polymorphic component with typed tests.

title: Discriminated unions as compile-time state machines

curriculum.learner_outcome: Model async and UI states as discriminated unions so impossible combinations cannot compile.
curriculum.production_scenario: A component renders a spinner and an error at once because two booleans were both true.
misconceptions: Optional fields on one object cannot express mutually exclusive states.
curriculum.evidence: A type test showing an impossible state rejected by the compiler.
curriculum.artifact: A state model for one feature with transitions and tests.

title: Exhaustiveness checking with never and assertUnreachable

curriculum.learner_outcome: Make missing cases a compile error with never and assertUnreachable.
curriculum.production_scenario: A new union member is added and a switch silently returns undefined in production.
misconceptions: A default branch that returns a fallback hides the missing case instead of reporting it.
curriculum.evidence: A compile error produced by adding a member to the union.
curriculum.artifact: An assertUnreachable helper adopted across the domain's switches.

title: Type-safe event emitters and pub/sub contracts

curriculum.learner_outcome: Type an event emitter so each event name carries its payload type.
mechanisms: overloads versus generics for on and emit
curriculum.production_scenario: A listener receives the wrong payload because event names are plain strings.
misconceptions: A string union for names is not enough; the payload must be tied to the name.
curriculum.evidence: A type test rejecting a mismatched payload at emit and on.
curriculum.artifact: A typed emitter used for one subsystem with tests.

title: Ambient declarations and extending global or browser APIs safely

curriculum.learner_outcome: Extend global or browser types safely with ambient declarations and module augmentation.
curriculum.production_scenario: A window property is typed in one file and disappears once the file becomes a module.
misconceptions: A file with an import or export is a module; its declare global must be explicit.
curriculum.evidence: A declaration file that augments a global with a test file using it.
curriculum.artifact: A typings directory with documented augmentation rules.

title: What each strict compiler flag actually changes in real code

curriculum.learner_outcome: Enable each strict flag deliberately and estimate the diagnostics it will produce.
curriculum.production_scenario: Turning on strict in a large codebase produces thousands of errors and the migration stalls.
misconceptions: strict is a bundle; enabling flags one at a time makes the blast radius measurable.
curriculum.evidence: A diagnostics count per flag for the codebase.
curriculum.artifact: A flag-by-flag migration plan with counts and owners.

title: Bridging static types and runtime validation at the network edge

curriculum.learner_outcome: Validate untrusted data at the network edge and derive the static type from the validator.
curriculum.production_scenario: A backend field rename ships and the frontend crashes deep inside rendering.
misconceptions: A generated type describes what the server promises, not what it sent.
curriculum.evidence: A failing payload rejected at the boundary with the derived type unchanged.
curriculum.artifact: A boundary module with schemas and derived types for one API.

title: Generating typed API clients from OpenAPI and GraphQL schemas

curriculum.learner_outcome: Generate typed clients from OpenAPI or GraphQL schemas and keep them honest at runtime.
curriculum.production_scenario: The generated client is a week behind the deployed API and returns fields that no longer exist.
misconceptions: Generated types are only as current as the schema they were generated from.
curriculum.evidence: A CI check that regenerates and diffs the client against the live schema.
curriculum.artifact: A generated client with a drift check in the pipeline.

title: Typing generic data-fetching and async state hooks

curriculum.learner_outcome: Type a generic data-fetching hook whose result type follows the request.
curriculum.production_scenario: Every call site casts the hook's data because the generic parameter is never inferred.
misconceptions: A generic that must be specified by hand at every call is a sign the inference source is missing.
curriculum.evidence: Hover output at call sites showing inferred data types.
curriculum.artifact: A typed hook with tests for inference and states.

title: Sharing types across a monorepo without circular builds

curriculum.learner_outcome: Share types across packages without circular builds or duplicated declarations.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two packages import each other's types and the solution build cannot order them.
misconceptions: Importing a type still creates a project dependency for the build graph.
curriculum.evidence: A references graph with the cycle removed and the build order shown.
curriculum.artifact: A shared-types package with a documented dependency direction.

title: CLI UX: argv parsing, exit codes, and stderr contracts

curriculum.learner_outcome: Write a command-line tool whose argv, exit codes and output streams form a contract callers can rely on.
mechanisms: stdout for results, stderr for diagnostics
curriculum.production_scenario: A CI job parses the tool's output and breaks when an error message lands on standard output.
misconceptions: Printing an error and exiting 0 makes the failure invisible to every caller.
curriculum.evidence: A test asserting status and stream for success, usage error and runtime failure.
curriculum.artifact: A contract table and passing three-way test for one tool.

title: AST parsing pipelines: lexer, parser, and error recovery

curriculum.learner_outcome: Build a lexer and parser pipeline that recovers from errors and keeps producing a tree.
curriculum.production_scenario: A formatter stops at the first syntax error instead of formatting the rest of the file.
misconceptions: A parser that halts on the first error is useless inside an editor.
curriculum.evidence: A recovered tree for input with two errors and both diagnostics reported.
curriculum.artifact: A small parser with error recovery and position-accurate diagnostics.

title: Language Server Protocol: requests, capabilities, sync

curriculum.learner_outcome: Implement a language server that negotiates capabilities and synchronizes documents correctly.
curriculum.production_scenario: An editor shows stale diagnostics because the server assumed full sync while the client sent deltas.
misconceptions: Capabilities are negotiated; a server must not use features the client did not advertise.
curriculum.evidence: A trace of initialize, didChange deltas and published diagnostics.
curriculum.artifact: A minimal language server with a capability test.

title: Tree-sitter grammars, queries, and incremental reparse

curriculum.learner_outcome: Write a grammar and queries and explain how incremental reparsing reuses subtrees.
curriculum.production_scenario: Syntax highlighting flickers because every keystroke reparses the whole file.
misconceptions: Incremental parsing reuses unchanged subtrees; an edit far from a change costs little.
curriculum.evidence: A timing comparison of full parse and incremental reparse after one edit.
curriculum.artifact: A grammar with queries and an incremental reparse test.

title: Watch mode and incremental invalidation graphs

curriculum.learner_outcome: Design a watch mode with an invalidation graph so only affected work reruns.
curriculum.production_scenario: Saving one file rebuilds everything and the loop takes ten seconds.
misconceptions: Watching files is easy; knowing what depends on them is the work.
curriculum.evidence: A log showing the invalidated subset for one change.
curriculum.artifact: A watch mode with graph-based invalidation and a test.

title: Bundler module graphs, chunking, and treeshaking

curriculum.learner_outcome: Explain how a bundler builds a module graph, splits chunks and shakes unused exports.
curriculum.production_scenario: A tree-shaken bundle still contains a whole library because the package declares side effects.
misconceptions: Treeshaking removes unused exports only when the module is known to be side-effect free.
curriculum.evidence: A chunk report showing the removed exports after the flag is fixed.
curriculum.artifact: A bundle analysis with a documented chunking decision.

title: esbuild transform pipeline and plugin hooks

curriculum.learner_outcome: Use esbuild's transform and plugin hooks to move code through a pipeline deterministically.
curriculum.production_scenario: A plugin rewrites imports and breaks source maps for every downstream file.
misconceptions: A transform that does not preserve maps breaks debugging for everyone after it.
curriculum.evidence: A plugin test asserting output and map correctness.
curriculum.artifact: A transform plugin with map-preserving tests.

title: Source map v3 mappings, scopes, and debug fidelity

curriculum.learner_outcome: Read and compose source maps so stack traces and debuggers land on original code.
curriculum.production_scenario: The debugger shows compiled output because the bundler's map ignored the compiler's map.
misconceptions: Sequential transforms must compose maps or debugging lands in intermediate output.
curriculum.evidence: A remapped stack trace next to the raw one.
curriculum.artifact: A map composition check in the build with a test.

title: Codemods with jscodeshift and recast printers

curriculum.learner_outcome: Write codemods that transform code precisely and preserve formatting.
curriculum.production_scenario: A codemod reformats every touched file and the review is unreadable.
misconceptions: Printing the whole file loses formatting; print only what changed.
curriculum.evidence: A diff showing only the intended changes across a sample repository.
curriculum.artifact: A codemod with fixtures and a dry-run report.

title: Test runner isolation: workers, VM contexts, snapshots

curriculum.learner_outcome: Explain how test runners isolate tests with workers, contexts and snapshots.
curriculum.production_scenario: Tests pass alone and fail together because a module-level cache leaks between files.
misconceptions: Isolation is a runner feature with a cost; know which level you rely on.
curriculum.evidence: A run showing the leak with isolation off and its absence with isolation on.
curriculum.artifact: A runner configuration with documented isolation level.

title: Mocking boundaries without lying to the typechecker

curriculum.learner_outcome: Mock only at boundaries and keep mocks type-checked against the real contract.
curriculum.production_scenario: A mock returns a shape the real API stopped producing months ago.
misconceptions: A mock that compiles against a stale type is lying with confidence.
curriculum.evidence: A type error produced when the mocked contract changes.
curriculum.artifact: A mocking guideline with typed boundary mocks.

title: Debug Adapter Protocol and breakpoint binding

curriculum.learner_outcome: Bind breakpoints correctly through the Debug Adapter Protocol and source maps.
curriculum.production_scenario: Breakpoints turn grey because the adapter cannot map the file to the running code.
misconceptions: A breakpoint in an editor is a request; the adapter must verify it against real code.
curriculum.evidence: A trace of setBreakpoints responses with verified and unverified locations.
curriculum.artifact: A debug configuration with verified breakpoints for one project.

title: Monorepo task runners: hashing, caching, fan-in/out

curriculum.learner_outcome: Configure a task runner with input hashing and caching so only affected tasks run.
curriculum.production_scenario: CI rebuilds every package although one README changed.
misconceptions: Cache correctness depends on declaring every input; an undeclared input causes stale hits.
curriculum.evidence: A run log showing cache hits and the one affected task.
curriculum.artifact: A task configuration with declared inputs and measured cache hits.

title: Lint rule engines: selectors, autofixers, and severity

curriculum.learner_outcome: Write a lint rule with selectors, an autofixer and an appropriate severity.
curriculum.production_scenario: An autofix rewrites code incorrectly and CI applies it automatically.
misconceptions: An autofixer must be safe on every match, not just the common one.
curriculum.evidence: A rule test suite with valid, invalid and fixed cases.
curriculum.artifact: A custom rule with tests and a documented severity.

title: Plugin architectures: hooks, ordering, and isolation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Design a plugin system with ordered hooks and isolation between plugins.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two plugins mutate the same option and the result depends on load order.
misconceptions: Plugin order is part of the contract; make it explicit.
curriculum.evidence: A test demonstrating deterministic hook ordering.
curriculum.artifact: A plugin API with ordering rules and tests.

title: Deterministic CI builds and reproducible artifacts

curriculum.learner_outcome: Make builds reproducible so the same inputs produce byte-identical artifacts.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two builds of the same commit differ and the cache never hits.
misconceptions: A build is not reproducible until you have compared two runs.
curriculum.evidence: Two build hashes from separate runs of the same commit.
curriculum.artifact: A reproducibility check in CI with normalized inputs.

title: Devcontainer specs, features, and lifecycle hooks

curriculum.learner_outcome: Define a devcontainer with features and lifecycle hooks that onboards a machine reproducibly.
curriculum.production_scenario: New developers spend a day installing tools and still differ from CI.
misconceptions: A devcontainer is a spec; if CI does not use it too, two environments drift.
curriculum.evidence: A fresh container reaching a passing test run with no manual steps.
curriculum.artifact: A devcontainer spec used locally and in CI.

title: Agent tooling interfaces: MCP, permissions, and sandboxes

curriculum.learner_outcome: Expose tools to agents through MCP with explicit permissions and sandboxes.
curriculum.production_scenario: An agent tool can read any file because the server exposed the filesystem without limits.
misconceptions: A tool's power is defined by its sandbox, not its description.
curriculum.evidence: A denied-permission trace for an out-of-scope request.
curriculum.artifact: An MCP server with scoped tools and permission tests.

title: Vite's dev server and module-boundary hot reload

curriculum.learner_outcome: Explain how Vite serves modules on demand and how HMR boundaries accept updates.
curriculum.production_scenario: An edit reloads the whole page because no module in the chain accepts the update.
misconceptions: HMR propagates up until a boundary accepts; without one it falls back to a reload.
curriculum.evidence: A log of HMR update propagation and the accepting boundary.
curriculum.artifact: An HMR boundary map for one application.

title: CSS transform pipelines: PostCSS, scoping, and CSS Modules

curriculum.learner_outcome: Run CSS through a transform pipeline with scoping and modules without breaking cascade expectations.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two components share a class name and one silently restyles the other.
misconceptions: Scoping changes selectors, not specificity; the cascade still applies.
curriculum.evidence: A build output showing hashed class names and the plugin order.
curriculum.artifact: A CSS pipeline with scoping and an ordering test.

title: Component workbenches: isolated rendering and story indexing

curriculum.learner_outcome: Render components in isolation with indexed stories that double as tests and documentation.
curriculum.production_scenario: A component only works inside the app because it depends on global providers.
misconceptions: A component that cannot render in isolation has hidden dependencies.
curriculum.evidence: A story index with every component rendering without the app shell.
curriculum.artifact: A workbench with stories used as visual tests.

title: Module federation and micro-frontend runtime composition

curriculum.learner_outcome: Compose independently built applications at runtime with shared modules.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two remotes load two copies of a framework and state is split.
misconceptions: Sharing requires a single runtime instance, not merely matching versions.
curriculum.evidence: A network log with one shared instance loaded.
curriculum.artifact: A federation setup with a single-instance test.

title: Visual regression pipelines: diffing pixels without flaking

curriculum.learner_outcome: Build a visual regression pipeline whose diffs are stable across machines.
curriculum.production_scenario: Every run flags hundreds of one-pixel differences from font rendering.
misconceptions: Pixel diffs need controlled environments; otherwise noise hides real regressions.
curriculum.evidence: A stable baseline run with zero false diffs across two machines.
curriculum.artifact: A visual regression pipeline with documented thresholds.

title: Bundle size budgets and verifying treeshaking actually happened

curriculum.learner_outcome: Enforce bundle budgets in CI and verify that treeshaking removed what it should.
curriculum.production_scenario: A budget passes while an unused library is still fully included.
misconceptions: A passing budget does not prove treeshaking worked; inspect the chunk.
curriculum.evidence: A CI failure on a budget breach with the offending module named.
curriculum.artifact: A budget configuration with a treeshaking verification.

title: Browser automation architecture: Playwright and CDP under the hood

curriculum.learner_outcome: Automate browsers reliably and explain what the protocol does under the hood.
curriculum.production_scenario: A test clicks a button before it is attached and fails only in CI.
misconceptions: Waiting a fixed time is not synchronization; wait for actionability.
curriculum.evidence: A trace showing the actionability checks before a click.
curriculum.artifact: An automation suite with traces retained on failure.

title: Performance budgets enforced in CI with Lighthouse

curriculum.learner_outcome: Enforce performance budgets in CI with Lighthouse runs that are stable enough to gate merges.
curriculum.production_scenario: A budget gate fails randomly because single runs vary by ten points.
misconceptions: A single lab run is noise; gate on medians of repeated runs.
curriculum.evidence: A CI report with medians over repeated runs and the assertion results.
curriculum.artifact: A Lighthouse CI configuration with stable assertions.

title: Design token pipelines: one source, many platforms

curriculum.learner_outcome: Transform one token source into platform outputs deterministically.
curriculum.production_scenario: iOS and web colors drift because two token files are edited by hand.
misconceptions: A token pipeline is only a source of truth if every platform consumes its output.
curriculum.evidence: Generated outputs for two platforms from one source with a diff check.
curriculum.artifact: A token pipeline with generated outputs and CI checks.

title: Automating accessibility checks: axe-core in lint and CI

curriculum.learner_outcome: Automate accessibility checks in lint and CI and understand what they cannot catch.
curriculum.production_scenario: CI passes accessibility checks while keyboard navigation is broken.
misconceptions: Automated checks catch a fraction of issues; they gate regressions, not compliance.
curriculum.evidence: A CI run with an axe violation reported and fixed.
curriculum.artifact: An accessibility gate with documented coverage limits.

title: Versioning and changelogs for multi-package releases

curriculum.learner_outcome: Version and release multiple packages with changesets and generated changelogs.
curriculum.production_scenario: A breaking change ships as a patch and downstream builds break overnight.
misconceptions: Versioning is a per-change decision recorded with the change, not at release time.
curriculum.evidence: A release with correct bumps for dependents and a generated changelog.
curriculum.artifact: A release process with changesets in CI.

title: scheduler.yield, scheduler.postTask, and cooperative main-thread scheduling

curriculum.learner_outcome: Yield to the browser and prioritize work with scheduler.yield and scheduler.postTask.
curriculum.production_scenario: A data transformation blocks input for a second because it runs in one task.
misconceptions: setTimeout zero is not a yield with priority; it is a low-priority task.
curriculum.evidence: A trace showing the long task split into yielded chunks with input handled in between.
curriculum.artifact: A chunked processing helper with measured input latency.

title: View Transitions for same-document and cross-document navigation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Animate same-document and cross-document navigations with view transitions.
mechanisms: snapshot of old and new states
curriculum.production_scenario: A route change flashes and elements jump instead of moving.
misconceptions: A view transition captures snapshots; it does not animate live DOM.
curriculum.evidence: A recording of a transition with named elements moving between states.
curriculum.artifact: A navigation transition with a fallback when unsupported.

title: Speculation Rules: safe prefetch and prerender architecture

curriculum.learner_outcome: Prefetch and prerender likely navigations safely with speculation rules.
curriculum.production_scenario: A prerendered checkout page fires analytics and reserves stock before the user arrives.
misconceptions: A prerendered page runs; anything with side effects must wait for activation.
curriculum.evidence: A trace showing prerender activation and deferred side effects.
curriculum.artifact: A speculation policy with activation-safe scripts.

title: Debugging INP: input delay, processing, presentation, and long tasks

curriculum.learner_outcome: Break an interaction into input delay, processing and presentation and fix the dominant phase.
curriculum.production_scenario: Tapping a filter feels slow although the handler itself is fast.
misconceptions: A fast handler can still produce a slow interaction if rendering after it is expensive.
curriculum.evidence: An event timing breakdown for the slow interaction with the dominant phase named.
curriculum.artifact: An INP fix with before and after attribution.

title: Worker data ownership: structured clone and transferable objects

curriculum.learner_outcome: Decide when to clone, transfer or share data with a worker and prove ownership moved.
curriculum.production_scenario: A worker receives a large buffer per frame and both sides pay for the copy.
misconceptions: After a transfer the sender's buffer is detached; using it throws.
curriculum.evidence: A test showing the detached buffer after transfer and the timing difference.
curriculum.artifact: A data-ownership policy for one worker pipeline.

title: Cross-origin isolation, COOP/COEP, and high-power browser APIs

curriculum.learner_outcome: Enable cross-origin isolation with COOP and COEP and account for what stops loading.
mechanisms: opener policy isolating the browsing context
embedder policy requiring CORP or CORS
curriculum.production_scenario: Enabling shared memory breaks embedded third-party images across the site.
misconceptions: Isolation is a page-wide contract; every embedded resource must opt in.
curriculum.evidence: A report of blocked resources after enabling the headers and the fixes applied.
curriculum.artifact: An isolation rollout with a resource opt-in inventory.

title: Trusted Types, CSP, sanitization, and DOM injection sinks

curriculum.learner_outcome: Lock DOM injection sinks with Trusted Types and sanitize untrusted HTML at the boundary.
curriculum.production_scenario: A rich-text feature must render user HTML without opening an injection sink.
misconceptions: Sanitizing once at input is not enough if the value is later interpreted in another context.
curriculum.evidence: A CSP report showing blocked sink writes and the policy that allows sanitized values.
curriculum.artifact: A Trusted Types policy with sanitizer tests.

title: Browser RUM instrumentation with PerformanceObserver and attribution

curriculum.learner_outcome: Instrument real-user monitoring with attribution that points at code, not only at a metric.
curriculum.production_scenario: A vitals dashboard shows a regression but no one can tell which deploy or component caused it.
misconceptions: A metric without attribution and release context cannot be acted on.
curriculum.evidence: A beacon payload with attribution and release fields for one slow interaction.
curriculum.artifact: A RUM setup with attributed entries and a regression traced to a release.

title: Profiling JavaScript/WebAssembly call boundaries in browser workloads

curriculum.learner_outcome: Profile calls across the JavaScript and WebAssembly boundary and reduce their overhead.
curriculum.production_scenario: A wasm image filter is slower than JavaScript because it is called once per pixel.
misconceptions: Moving code to WebAssembly does not help if the boundary is crossed for every element.
curriculum.evidence: A profile comparing per-element calls with a batched call.
curriculum.artifact: A boundary redesign with measured call counts.

title: Permissions Policy, privacy constraints, and capability detection

curriculum.learner_outcome: Restrict powerful features with Permissions Policy and detect capabilities without fingerprinting users.
curriculum.production_scenario: A third-party iframe requests geolocation on a page that never intended to allow it.
misconceptions: A feature being present in the browser does not mean the page is allowed to use it.
curriculum.evidence: A policy header with a test that the feature is denied in the iframe.
curriculum.artifact: A permissions policy with capability detection documented.

title: unknown, any, never, and where type safety actually disappears

curriculum.learner_outcome: Recognize where checking stops and choose unknown, any or never deliberately.
curriculum.production_scenario: A payload typed any reaches a public function and a runtime crash looks like a compiler guarantee.
misconceptions: An assertion is an unchecked promise, not a check.
curriculum.evidence: A file whose diagnostics change when any becomes unknown.
curriculum.artifact: A boundary moved from any to unknown with narrowing and documented assertions.

title: Function contracts: parameters, callbacks, overloads, and assignability

curriculum.learner_outcome: Type parameters, callbacks and overloads so callers get correct inference and errors.
curriculum.production_scenario: An overloaded function accepts an argument combination no implementation handles.
misconceptions: Overload signatures are checked in order; the implementation signature is not visible to callers.
curriculum.evidence: A test showing a rejected call and the overload that matched.
curriculum.artifact: A function contract guideline with reviewed overloads.

title: Literal inference, as const, readonly, and immutable data shapes

curriculum.learner_outcome: Preserve literal types with as const, readonly and satisfies where the value's exact shape matters.
curriculum.production_scenario: A route table loses its literal paths and links accept any string.
misconceptions: A literal is widened unless something asks for it to stay narrow.
curriculum.evidence: Hover output showing widened versus preserved literals.
curriculum.artifact: A constants module with preserved literals and tests.

title: Modeling product states with unions instead of optional-field bags

curriculum.learner_outcome: Model states as unions of complete shapes instead of one object with optional fields.
curriculum.production_scenario: A form model with twelve optional fields allows states no screen can render.
misconceptions: Optional fields do not encode which combinations are valid.
curriculum.evidence: A type test rejecting an invalid combination.
curriculum.artifact: A remodelled domain type with migration notes.

title: Designing readable public types for components and packages

curriculum.learner_outcome: Design public types that read well in hovers and stay stable across releases.
curriculum.production_scenario: A package's hover shows a two-hundred-line expanded type and users give up.
misconceptions: A clever type that is correct but unreadable is a bad public contract.
curriculum.evidence: Hover captures before and after naming the public types.
curriculum.artifact: A reviewed public type surface with a changelog.

title: Const type parameters and preserving literal intent through APIs

curriculum.learner_outcome: Keep literal intent through generic APIs with const type parameters.
curriculum.production_scenario: A builder loses the literal keys passed to it and returns string.
misconceptions: Callers should not need as const at every call site to keep literals.
curriculum.evidence: Hover output with and without the const modifier.
curriculum.artifact: A builder API preserving literals with tests.

title: Type-safe route params, search params, links, and loader contracts

curriculum.learner_outcome: Type route params, search params and links so navigation targets are checked at compile time.
curriculum.production_scenario: A renamed route breaks links across the app without any compiler error.
misconceptions: A string path is not a route; typing it as a literal pattern lets the compiler check links.
curriculum.evidence: A type test rejecting a link to a nonexistent route.
curriculum.artifact: A typed router module with link and param tests.

title: Typed forms without lying: DOM values, schemas, and submission states

curriculum.learner_outcome: Type forms from DOM values through validation to submission states without lying about what exists.
curriculum.production_scenario: A form's typed model claims numbers while every field arrives as a string.
misconceptions: Input values are strings until something parses them.
curriculum.evidence: A test showing the string-to-domain parse and a rejected invalid input.
curriculum.artifact: A form contract with schema and submission states.

title: Type-safe environment and runtime configuration boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Validate environment and runtime configuration once and expose a typed, frozen config.
curriculum.production_scenario: A missing environment variable is read as undefined deep in a request handler.
misconceptions: Declaring an env variable's type does not make it present.
curriculum.evidence: A startup failure with a clear message for a missing variable.
curriculum.artifact: A validated configuration module with tests.

title: Type-aware lint rules, program reuse, and CI performance

curriculum.learner_outcome: Run type-aware lint rules with program reuse so CI stays fast.
curriculum.production_scenario: Type-aware linting doubles CI time because each file builds its own program.
misconceptions: Type-aware rules need a program; building one per file is the slow path.
curriculum.evidence: A timing comparison with and without project service reuse.
curriculum.artifact: A lint configuration with measured CI time.

title: Package exports, declaration maps, and ESM-first library publishing

curriculum.learner_outcome: Publish an ESM-first library with an exports map, declarations and declaration maps that consumers resolve correctly.
curriculum.production_scenario: Consumers on node16 resolution cannot find the package's types.
misconceptions: A types field at the top level does not satisfy an exports map; the condition must be inside it.
curriculum.evidence: A consumer test project resolving types under two resolution modes.
curriculum.artifact: A publishing checklist with a resolution test.

title: Type complexity budgets: inference cliffs and editor latency

curriculum.learner_outcome: Set and enforce budgets for type complexity so editors stay responsive.
curriculum.production_scenario: A single utility type makes every file that imports it slow to type-check.
misconceptions: The compiler's limits are not the budget; editor latency is.
curriculum.evidence: A trace identifying the expensive instantiation.
curriculum.artifact: A complexity budget with a CI check on diagnostics.

title: TypeScript 6 deprecations and migration toward the TypeScript 7 native compiler

curriculum.learner_outcome: Prepare a codebase for the native compiler by removing deprecated options and verifying parity.
curriculum.production_scenario: The native compiler rejects an option the JavaScript compiler still accepts.
misconceptions: A faster compiler with different flag coverage is a migration, not a drop-in swap.
curriculum.evidence: A CI job running both compilers with differences listed.
curriculum.artifact: A migration note with recorded versions and unsupported options.

title: Baseline, Browserslist, polyfill policy, and support matrices

curriculum.learner_outcome: Define a support matrix with Baseline and Browserslist and a polyfill policy that follows it.
curriculum.production_scenario: A feature ships that fails on a supported browser because nobody checked its status.
misconceptions: A polyfill policy without a support matrix is guesswork.
curriculum.evidence: A support matrix with the feature checked against it.
curriculum.artifact: A targets policy with a verified polyfill set.

title: pnpm workspaces, catalogs, lockfiles, and dependency policy

curriculum.learner_outcome: Manage workspaces, catalogs and lockfiles with a dependency policy the team can enforce.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two packages depend on different versions of the same library and both ship.
misconceptions: A lockfile records what was installed; a policy decides what is allowed.
curriculum.evidence: A dependency audit listing duplicates and the catalog fix.
curriculum.artifact: A workspace policy with enforced catalogs.

title: Rust-native bundler pipelines: Rolldown, Oxc, Rspack, and Turbopack

curriculum.learner_outcome: Evaluate Rust-native bundler pipelines by parity and measurement rather than benchmarks.
curriculum.production_scenario: A faster bundler drops a plugin the build depends on.
misconceptions: Speed is not the first question; parity with the current build is.
curriculum.evidence: A parity checklist output for the candidate bundler.
curriculum.artifact: A bundler evaluation with parity and timing evidence.

title: Biome, ESLint, and typed-analysis pipeline trade-offs

curriculum.learner_outcome: Choose between fast unified linters and typed analysis pipelines by what each can prove.
curriculum.production_scenario: A fast linter replaces a typed one and type-dependent rules silently stop running.
misconceptions: Rules that need types cannot run in a tool that does not build a program.
curriculum.evidence: A rule coverage comparison between the two configurations.
curriculum.artifact: A linting architecture with documented coverage.

title: Real-browser component testing and framework mount adapters

curriculum.learner_outcome: Test components in a real browser with framework mount adapters.
curriculum.production_scenario: A component passes in a simulated DOM and fails on real layout.
misconceptions: A simulated DOM has no layout; anything measuring geometry needs a browser.
curriculum.evidence: A test failing in a simulated DOM and passing in a browser with the cause named.
curriculum.artifact: A browser-mode component test setup with mount adapters.

title: CI test sharding, retries, quarantine, and flake ownership

curriculum.learner_outcome: Shard CI tests, retry deliberately and quarantine flakes with owners.
curriculum.production_scenario: A flaky test is retried three times and nobody owns fixing it.
misconceptions: Retries hide flakes; quarantine with ownership surfaces them.
curriculum.evidence: A flake report with owners and quarantine age.
curriculum.artifact: A CI test policy with sharding and quarantine.

title: Dev-server security: host checks, proxy trust, and source exposure

curriculum.learner_outcome: Harden a dev server against host, proxy and source exposure risks.
curriculum.production_scenario: A dev server bound to all interfaces exposes source files on the office network.
misconceptions: A dev server is a server; defaults matter on shared networks.
curriculum.evidence: A scan showing exposed endpoints before and after hardening.
curriculum.artifact: A hardened dev server configuration with a verification scan.

title: Production source-map privacy, upload, and error symbolication

curriculum.learner_outcome: Upload production source maps privately and symbolicate errors without exposing sources.
curriculum.production_scenario: Production maps are public and the whole source is one request away.
misconceptions: Source maps for symbolication do not need to be served to browsers.
curriculum.evidence: A symbolicated error with maps stored privately.
curriculum.artifact: An error pipeline with private maps.

title: Frontend supply-chain controls: provenance, lockfiles, audits, and policy

curriculum.learner_outcome: Apply provenance, lockfile and audit controls to the frontend supply chain.
curriculum.production_scenario: A compromised dependency runs a postinstall script on every developer machine.
misconceptions: An audit warning is not a control; blocking install scripts is.
curriculum.evidence: A CI check failing on a lockfile mismatch or unapproved script.
curriculum.artifact: A supply-chain policy with enforced checks.

title: Repository generators that encode architecture without hiding it

curriculum.learner_outcome: Write generators that encode architecture decisions without hiding them.
curriculum.production_scenario: Generated projects drift from the template within months and nobody notices.
misconceptions: A generator that hides structure makes the architecture unlearnable.
curriculum.evidence: A drift report between generated projects and the template.
curriculum.artifact: A generator with visible structure and drift checks.

title: Cross-browser compatibility CI with feature detection and targeted suites

curriculum.learner_outcome: Run cross-browser CI with feature detection and targeted suites.
curriculum.production_scenario: The whole suite runs on six browsers and takes an hour for one CSS change.
misconceptions: Not every test needs every browser; target by capability.
curriculum.evidence: A CI matrix with suites assigned by capability and the time saved.
curriculum.artifact: A compatibility CI configuration with targeted suites.

title: Evaluating AI-authored code changes with sandboxes, tests, and policy gates

curriculum.learner_outcome: Evaluate AI-authored changes with sandboxes, tests and policy gates before merge.
curriculum.production_scenario: An AI-authored change passes review because nobody ran it.
misconceptions: A change is evaluated by running it, not by reading it.
curriculum.evidence: A gate report with tests, policy checks and sandbox results.
curriculum.artifact: An evaluation pipeline for AI-authored changes.

title: Domain-oriented frontend boundaries and public feature contracts

curriculum.learner_outcome: Draw feature boundaries with explicit public contracts so teams change internals without breaking neighbours.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two features import each other's internals and a refactor in one breaks the other's build.
misconceptions: A folder structure is not a boundary; only an enforced public surface is.
curriculum.evidence: A boundary lint report before and after the rule is enforced.
curriculum.artifact: A boundary map with enforced public entry points for one product area.

title: Component API design: controlled state, composition, and escape hatches

curriculum.learner_outcome: Design component APIs with controlled and uncontrolled state, composition and documented escape hatches.
curriculum.production_scenario: A select component grows thirty boolean props and nobody can predict their combinations.
misconceptions: More props do not make a component more flexible; composition does.
curriculum.evidence: A usage review comparing prop-driven and composed versions of one component.
curriculum.artifact: A component API guideline with a refactored reference component.

title: Routes as product, data, error, and ownership boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Treat routes as product, data, error and ownership boundaries rather than URL patterns.
curriculum.production_scenario: A single global loader fetches every screen's data and one slow query blocks the whole app.
misconceptions: A route is a unit of ownership and failure, not only a path.
curriculum.evidence: A route map naming data, error handling and owner for each segment.
curriculum.artifact: A route architecture record for one application.

title: State placement: local, URL, server cache, shared client, and persistent

curriculum.learner_outcome: Place each value in the smallest store every reader can reach: local, URL, server cache, shared client or persistent.
mechanisms: audience and lifetime of a value
curriculum.production_scenario: A filter resets on back navigation and a server record is edited in a client store.
misconceptions: Hoisting state outward is a cost, not a default.
curriculum.evidence: A placement table for one screen with justified moves.
curriculum.artifact: A state placement guideline with a re-placed screen.

title: Server, client, edge, and browser capability boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Decide what runs on the server, the edge, the client and the browser by capability and cost.
curriculum.production_scenario: Code that needs a secret ends up in the client bundle.
misconceptions: A file can run anywhere in a framework; where it must run is a design decision.
curriculum.evidence: A boundary map marking each module's runtime and why.
curriculum.artifact: A runtime boundary record for one feature.

title: Server data, client caches, freshness, identity, and invalidation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Model server data as a cache with identity, freshness and invalidation rules.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two screens show different versions of the same record after an edit.
misconceptions: A client copy of server data is a cache, not a second source of truth.
curriculum.evidence: A cache-key and invalidation table for one domain.
curriculum.artifact: A data layer with documented freshness rules.

title: Design-system contracts: tokens, primitives, components, and policy

curriculum.learner_outcome: Separate tokens, primitives, components and policy so each layer changes at its own pace.
curriculum.production_scenario: A brand refresh requires editing hundreds of components because colors are hard-coded.
misconceptions: A design system is a set of contracts, not a component library.
curriculum.evidence: A layer diagram with the change path for one token.
curriculum.artifact: A design-system layering document with one migrated component.

title: Accessibility architecture: semantic ownership and focus contracts

curriculum.learner_outcome: Assign semantic and focus ownership so accessibility survives composition.
curriculum.production_scenario: A modal inside a drawer traps focus in the wrong container.
misconceptions: Accessibility is not a final audit; it is an ownership contract per component.
curriculum.evidence: An accessibility tree inspection for a composed screen with owners named.
curriculum.artifact: A focus and semantics contract for the component library.

title: Performance budgets as architectural constraints

curriculum.learner_outcome: Set performance budgets as constraints that architecture decisions must satisfy.
curriculum.production_scenario: A new dependency pushes the bundle past its budget and nobody notices until users complain.
misconceptions: A budget that is not enforced is a wish.
curriculum.evidence: A CI check failing on a budget breach with the offending change.
curriculum.artifact: A budget document with enforcement in the pipeline.

title: Choosing CSR, SSR, SSG, streaming, and islands per route

curriculum.learner_outcome: Choose CSR, SSR, SSG, streaming or islands per route from its data, personalization and interactivity.
curriculum.production_scenario: A personalized page is statically generated and leaks another user's data through a cache.
misconceptions: A rendering strategy is a per-route decision.
curriculum.evidence: A route table with strategy, cache rule and measured metrics.
curriculum.artifact: A rendering decision record for one application.

title: Backend-for-Frontend boundaries, API composition, and overfetching

curriculum.learner_outcome: Introduce a backend-for-frontend when composition, overfetching or auth shape demands it.
mechanisms: auth and session termination at the BFF
curriculum.production_scenario: A mobile screen makes nine calls to render one list.
misconceptions: A BFF is owned by the frontend team and shaped by screens, not by services.
curriculum.evidence: A request count and payload size comparison before and after composition.
curriculum.artifact: A BFF boundary decision with measured request reduction.

title: URL and navigation state as durable application architecture

curriculum.learner_outcome: Make the URL and navigation history durable application state with restoration rules.
curriculum.production_scenario: Pressing back after a modal closes the whole flow.
misconceptions: If the back button should change it, it belongs in the navigation state.
curriculum.evidence: A navigation transcript showing entries and restoration for one flow.
curriculum.artifact: A navigation state design for one application area.

title: Async UI state machines for loading, stale, error, retry, and cancellation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Model async UI as explicit states with transitions for retry, cancellation and stale data.
curriculum.production_scenario: A component shows a spinner and an error at once because booleans disagree.
misconceptions: Booleans admit impossible combinations; a union names the states that exist.
curriculum.evidence: A type test rejecting an impossible state and a trace of a cancelled request.
curriculum.artifact: An async state model reused across features.

title: Headless components, slots, compound APIs, and behavior ownership

curriculum.learner_outcome: Separate behavior from rendering with headless components, slots and compound APIs.
curriculum.production_scenario: A dropdown's keyboard behavior is copied into five differently styled variants.
misconceptions: Style variants should share one behavior implementation.
curriculum.evidence: A composition demo with one behavior and three renderings.
curriculum.artifact: A headless primitive with documented composition.

title: Design tokens, themes, modes, and cross-platform semantic layers

curriculum.learner_outcome: Build a semantic token layer that supports themes, modes and platforms without forks.
curriculum.production_scenario: Dark mode requires a second stylesheet that drifts from the first.
misconceptions: Themes are token values, not separate components.
curriculum.evidence: A theme switch demo with a single component tree.
curriculum.artifact: A semantic token layer with two modes.

title: Error boundaries, degraded UX, retries, and partial failure

curriculum.learner_outcome: Contain failures with boundaries and design degraded experiences and retries deliberately.
curriculum.production_scenario: One failing widget blanks the entire dashboard for every user at once.
misconceptions: Catching an error is not resilience; deciding what the user sees is.
curriculum.evidence: A failure injection showing the contained region and the degraded state.
curriculum.artifact: A resilience map with boundaries and degraded states.

title: Frontend observability: RUM, traces, errors, releases, and user context

curriculum.learner_outcome: Instrument real-user monitoring with traces, errors, releases and user context that point at causes.
curriculum.production_scenario: A regression is visible in metrics but cannot be tied to a deploy or a component.
misconceptions: A metric without release and attribution context cannot be acted on.
curriculum.evidence: A RUM event with release, route and attribution fields for one regression.
curriculum.artifact: An observability setup that traced one regression to its release.

title: Testing architecture: contracts, components, journeys, and confidence

curriculum.learner_outcome: Choose tests by the contract they protect: unit, component, contract and journey.
curriculum.production_scenario: Hundreds of snapshot tests pass while a checkout journey is broken.
misconceptions: Coverage is not confidence; the right test at the right boundary is.
curriculum.evidence: A test map assigning each contract to a test type.
curriculum.artifact: A testing architecture record with the journeys covered.

title: Frontend trust boundaries: untrusted data, secrets, auth, and browser policy

curriculum.learner_outcome: Mark trust boundaries for untrusted data, secrets, auth and browser policy in the frontend.
curriculum.production_scenario: An API key ships in the client bundle because it was needed for a request.
misconceptions: The browser is not a trusted environment; anything sent to it is public.
curriculum.evidence: A trust-boundary review listing each secret's location and each sink.
curriculum.artifact: A trust boundary document with fixes applied.

title: Realtime frontend architecture: ordering, reconnects, backpressure, and presence

curriculum.learner_outcome: Design realtime frontends for ordering, reconnects, backpressure and presence.
curriculum.production_scenario: A live dashboard shows events out of order after a reconnect.
misconceptions: A live connection does not guarantee order or delivery across reconnects.
curriculum.evidence: A reconnect test showing resumed, ordered delivery.
curriculum.artifact: A realtime client with ordering and resume tests.

title: Offline-first data: local authority, sync queues, and conflict resolution

curriculum.learner_outcome: Give local data authority when offline and sync with conflict resolution rules.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two devices edit the same note offline and one edit disappears.
misconceptions: Last write wins is a decision with data loss, not a default.
curriculum.evidence: A conflict scenario resolved by the chosen rule with both edits accounted for.
curriculum.artifact: An offline data layer with a documented conflict policy.

title: Internationalization architecture: messages, formats, routing, and layout

curriculum.learner_outcome: Architect messages, formats, routing and layout for many locales from the start.
curriculum.production_scenario: Right-to-left users see mirrored icons and truncated plurals.
misconceptions: Translation is the last step; formats, routing and layout come first.
curriculum.evidence: A locale switch demo covering plurals, dates and RTL layout.
curriculum.artifact: An internationalization architecture record for one application.

title: Monorepo modularity: package graph, ownership, boundaries, and releases

curriculum.learner_outcome: Structure a monorepo package graph with ownership, boundaries and release rules.
curriculum.production_scenario: A shared package changes and forty consumers break in one commit.
misconceptions: A monorepo does not remove versioning; it moves it into the graph.
curriculum.evidence: A package graph with ownership and the affected consumers for one change.
curriculum.artifact: A modularity record with enforced boundaries.

title: Micro-frontends: when independent deployment earns runtime complexity

curriculum.learner_outcome: Decide whether independent deployment justifies micro-frontend runtime complexity.
curriculum.production_scenario: Three teams ship one page and every release blocks on the others.
misconceptions: Micro-frontends solve an organizational problem and create a runtime one.
curriculum.evidence: A decision record weighing deployment gains against runtime cost with numbers.
curriculum.artifact: A micro-frontend decision record for one product.

title: Server Components, streaming UI, serialization, and mutation boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Use server components and streaming with clear serialization and mutation boundaries.
curriculum.production_scenario: A server component passes a function to a client component and the build fails.
misconceptions: Server and client components are a boundary, not a performance flag.
curriculum.evidence: A boundary check output for one component tree.
curriculum.artifact: A streaming architecture slice with boundaries documented.

title: Islands, partial hydration, resumability, and interaction boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Hydrate only interactive islands and decide interaction boundaries per component.
curriculum.production_scenario: A content page ships a large bundle to hydrate static text.
misconceptions: Hydration re-executes component logic; islands limit where.
curriculum.evidence: A trace of hydrated islands versus full hydration.
curriculum.artifact: An island boundary map with measured bundle reduction.

title: Mutation architecture: optimistic UI, invalidation, conflicts, and rollback

curriculum.learner_outcome: Design mutations with optimistic UI, invalidation, conflict handling and rollback.
curriculum.production_scenario: An optimistic insert fails on the server and a phantom row remains.
misconceptions: Optimistic updates without rollback are lies the UI tells.
curriculum.evidence: A test showing rollback after a failed mutation.
curriculum.artifact: A mutation architecture with tested rollback.

title: Feature flags, progressive delivery, kill switches, and cleanup

curriculum.learner_outcome: Roll features out progressively with flags, kill switches and cleanup rules.
curriculum.production_scenario: A flag stays for two years and both branches ship forever.
misconceptions: A flag is a temporary structure with a removal date.
curriculum.evidence: A flag inventory with ages and owners.
curriculum.artifact: A progressive delivery process with a cleanup rule.

title: Design-system governance: adoption, versioning, migrations, and exceptions

curriculum.learner_outcome: Govern a design system's adoption, versioning, migrations and exceptions.
curriculum.production_scenario: Teams pin old versions and the system fragments into five variants.
misconceptions: Adoption is governed by migration cost, not by mandate.
curriculum.evidence: An adoption dashboard with versions in use and a migration path.
curriculum.artifact: A governance record with a migration plan.

title: Multi-tenant and white-label frontend architecture without forks

curriculum.learner_outcome: Serve many tenants and brands from one codebase through configuration, tokens and boundaries.
curriculum.production_scenario: A white-label client gets a fork and diverges within a quarter.
misconceptions: A fork is the most expensive configuration mechanism.
curriculum.evidence: A tenant matrix showing configuration instead of forks.
curriculum.artifact: A multi-tenant architecture record with one onboarded tenant.

title: Frontend platform teams: paved roads, autonomy, metrics, and governance

curriculum.learner_outcome: Run a frontend platform team with paved roads, autonomy and measurable adoption.
curriculum.production_scenario: A platform mandates tooling nobody adopts and teams build their own.
misconceptions: A platform earns adoption by being the easiest path, not by mandate.
curriculum.evidence: An adoption metric trend for one paved road.
curriculum.artifact: A platform charter with measured adoption.

title: Frontend incident response: detection, triage, rollback, and learning

curriculum.learner_outcome: Detect, triage, roll back and learn from frontend incidents.
curriculum.production_scenario: A bad deploy takes an hour to notice and longer to revert.
misconceptions: Fixing forward is slower than rolling back.
curriculum.evidence: An incident timeline with detection, rollback and learning.
curriculum.artifact: An incident runbook for the frontend.

title: Large data interfaces: virtualization, pagination, workers, and interaction budgets

curriculum.learner_outcome: Render large datasets within interaction budgets using virtualization, pagination and workers.
curriculum.production_scenario: A ten-thousand-row table freezes the tab on sort.
misconceptions: Rendering only what is visible is the first optimization, not the last.
curriculum.evidence: A profile comparing full render and virtualized render.
curriculum.artifact: A large-data component with measured interaction latency.

title: Edge rendering and personalization without cache or privacy leaks

curriculum.learner_outcome: Personalize at the edge without leaking across cache keys or privacy boundaries.
curriculum.production_scenario: A personalized banner is cached and shown to the wrong user.
misconceptions: Personalization and caching conflict unless the cache key includes the variant.
curriculum.evidence: A cache key audit for one personalized route.
curriculum.artifact: An edge personalization design with a privacy review.

title: Incremental frontend architecture migrations with stranglers and compatibility layers

curriculum.learner_outcome: Migrate architecture incrementally with stranglers and compatibility layers.
curriculum.production_scenario: A rewrite runs for two years while the old app still gets features.
misconceptions: A rewrite without a strangler never catches up.
curriculum.evidence: A migration map with routes moved and remaining.
curriculum.artifact: A migration plan with measured progress.

title: Designing a reference frontend architecture for many teams and surfaces

curriculum.learner_outcome: Design a reference architecture that many teams can adopt with local variation.
curriculum.production_scenario: Every team invents its own data layer and nothing composes.
misconceptions: A reference architecture is adopted through defaults and checks, not documents.
curriculum.evidence: A conformance report for one team's application.
curriculum.artifact: A reference architecture with conformance checks.

title: Frontend capacity and cost modeling across edge, server, network, and browser

curriculum.learner_outcome: Model capacity and cost across edge, server, network and browser for frontend decisions.
curriculum.production_scenario: A rendering change doubles server cost at peak without anyone forecasting it.
misconceptions: Browser cost is paid by users; server cost is paid by the company; both are budgets.
curriculum.evidence: A cost model comparing two rendering options at peak traffic.
curriculum.artifact: A capacity and cost model for one application.

title: AI-native frontend architecture: streaming, tool states, citations, and trust

curriculum.learner_outcome: Architect AI-driven interfaces with streaming, tool states, citations and trust signals.
curriculum.production_scenario: A chat interface shows a partial answer as final and cites nothing.
misconceptions: Streaming output is a state, not a rendering trick.
curriculum.evidence: A state trace for a streamed response with tool calls.
curriculum.artifact: An AI interaction architecture slice with citations.

title: Navigation API: intercepting and coordinating SPA navigations

curriculum.learner_outcome: Intercept and coordinate single-page navigations with the Navigation API.
curriculum.production_scenario: Two quick clicks race and the app renders the earlier route last.
misconceptions: Intercepting a navigation is a promise the app must settle; an unsettled one leaves the URL in limbo.
curriculum.evidence: A trace of two navigations where the first is aborted by the second.
curriculum.artifact: A router built on the Navigation API with abort tests.

title: Popover, dialog, and declarative invoker primitives

curriculum.learner_outcome: Use popover, dialog and invoker attributes for accessible overlays without custom focus code.
curriculum.production_scenario: A custom modal traps focus wrongly and cannot be closed with Escape.
misconceptions: A dialog opened with show() is not modal; only showModal() makes the rest inert.
curriculum.evidence: A demo showing top-layer stacking, light dismiss and focus return.
curriculum.artifact: An overlay component using native primitives with an accessibility check.

title: Storage partitioning, CHIPS, and third-party privacy boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Explain storage partitioning by top-level site and use partitioned cookies where embedding requires them.
curriculum.production_scenario: An embedded widget loses its session between different host sites.
misconceptions: Storage in a third-party iframe is keyed by the embedding site, not shared across hosts.
curriculum.evidence: A test showing separate storage per top-level site and a working partitioned cookie.
curriculum.artifact: An embedding strategy with partitioned storage handling.

title: WebGPU and OffscreenCanvas workload architecture

curriculum.learner_outcome: Move rendering work to a worker with OffscreenCanvas and structure WebGPU workloads for responsiveness.
mechanisms: canvas control transferred to a worker
frame scheduling off the main thread
curriculum.production_scenario: A visualization stalls input because it draws on the main thread each frame.
misconceptions: GPU work is asynchronous; submitting it does not mean the frame is ready.
curriculum.evidence: A trace showing main-thread idle time with rendering in a worker.
curriculum.artifact: A worker-rendered pipeline with measured main-thread cost.

title: Intl runtime: locale-sensitive formatting, plural rules, and segmentation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Format numbers, dates and plurals per locale and segment text correctly with Intl.
curriculum.production_scenario: A counter says '1 items' and a name is truncated inside an emoji.
misconceptions: String length counts code units, not characters a user sees.
curriculum.evidence: A table of formatted outputs across three locales with segmentation examples.
curriculum.artifact: A localization helper with plural and segmentation tests.

title: Explicit resource management with using and DisposableStack

curriculum.learner_outcome: Release resources deterministically with using declarations and DisposableStack.

title: Runtime schema architecture: Zod, Valibot, and generated validators

curriculum.learner_outcome: Choose and structure runtime schema libraries so validation and static types stay in one place.

misconceptions: A schema library is an architecture decision, not a utility import.
curriculum.evidence: A comparison of bundle size and inference for the same schema.
curriculum.artifact: A schema architecture record with one chosen approach.

title: Typing server actions and serialized React boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Type server actions and serialized boundaries so only serializable values cross.
curriculum.production_scenario: A server component passes a class instance to a client component and it arrives as a plain object.
