curriculum.artifact: A boundary typing module with tests.

title: Svelte 5 runes and component contract typing

curriculum.learner_outcome: Type Svelte 5 component props, snippets and rune state as contracts.
curriculum.production_scenario: A component's prop types drift from what parents pass because they were never declared.
misconceptions: Runes infer state, but component contracts still need explicit prop types.
curriculum.evidence: A svelte-check run showing a rejected prop at a call site.
curriculum.artifact: A typed component library slice with checks in CI.

title: Operating the native TypeScript compiler in editor, CI, and monorepo workflows

curriculum.learner_outcome: Run the language service, tsc -b and the native compiler on one workspace and reconcile their results.
curriculum.production_scenario: CI passes with the native compiler while developers see a diagnostic the JavaScript compiler reports.
misconceptions: Three tools reading one tsconfig can still disagree; differences must be recorded, not assumed away.
curriculum.evidence: A CI log running both compilers with the diagnostics compared.
curriculum.artifact: A package shipped through all three inspections with a migration note.

title: Frontend authentication architecture: PKCE, sessions, refresh, and BFF boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Design frontend authentication with PKCE, sessions, refresh and a BFF boundary.
curriculum.production_scenario: Access tokens live in localStorage and an XSS drains them.
misconceptions: Tokens in the browser are exposed; a BFF keeps them server-side.
curriculum.evidence: A sequence diagram with tokens never reaching the browser.
curriculum.artifact: An auth architecture with a BFF session boundary.

title: Consumer-driven contract testing for frontend/API evolution

curriculum.learner_outcome: Test API evolution with consumer-driven contracts so frontends and services change safely.
curriculum.production_scenario: A backend renames a field and three frontends break in production.
misconceptions: An integration test against a live API is not a contract.
curriculum.evidence: A provider verification run failing on the renamed field.
curriculum.artifact: A contract suite for one consumer and provider.

title: Feature flags, experimentation, and evidence-driven cleanup

curriculum.learner_outcome: Run experiments behind flags with evidence-driven decisions and cleanup.
curriculum.production_scenario: An experiment runs indefinitely because nobody set a decision date.
misconceptions: An experiment without a decision date is technical debt.
curriculum.evidence: An experiment record with exposure, metric and decision.
curriculum.artifact: An experimentation process with decision dates and cleanup.

title: Edge middleware, geo routing, and personalization boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Use edge middleware for geo routing and personalization within clear boundaries.
curriculum.production_scenario: Edge middleware personalizes a cached page and mixes regions.
misconceptions: The edge sees the request, not the user's session state.
curriculum.evidence: A trace showing edge decisions and the cache key used.
curriculum.artifact: An edge middleware decision record with boundaries.

title: Server component serialization and mutation boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Encode the serialization boundary as a checked allow-list and run mutations behind validated actions.
curriculum.production_scenario: A callback prop crosses the server boundary and fails in production.
misconceptions: Props that crossed the boundary are copies; edits never reach the server without an action.
curriculum.evidence: A boundary checker output for three real props and a rollback test.
curriculum.artifact: A boundary and mutation contract with an ADR and rollback path.

title: Vitest worker pools, isolation, and deterministic test architecture

curriculum.learner_outcome: Configure Vitest worker pools and isolation for deterministic, fast runs.
curriculum.production_scenario: Tests are fast but nondeterministic because files share a worker.
misconceptions: Speed from shared workers costs isolation; choose per suite.
curriculum.evidence: Two runs with identical results under the chosen pool.
curriculum.artifact: A Vitest configuration with documented pool choices.

title: Oxc, SWC, and Babel transform pipeline trade-offs

curriculum.learner_outcome: Compare transform pipelines by correctness, plugin needs and speed on your code.
curriculum.production_scenario: A faster transformer mis-handles a decorator syntax the project uses.
misconceptions: A transformer is correct for your code only when your code is the test.
curriculum.evidence: A parity run of the project's transforms across pipelines.
curriculum.artifact: A transform pipeline decision with parity evidence.

title: Dependency hygiene and dead-code analysis with Knip-style graphs

curriculum.learner_outcome: Find unused files, exports and dependencies with graph analysis and keep them out.
curriculum.production_scenario: A package carries forty unused dependencies and a hundred dead exports.
misconceptions: Unused code is a graph question; grep cannot answer it.
curriculum.evidence: A report of unused items with the fixes applied.
curriculum.artifact: A hygiene check in CI with declared entry points.

title: TypeScript language-service plugin architecture

curriculum.learner_outcome: Build a language-service plugin that adds diagnostics without slowing the editor.
curriculum.production_scenario: A plugin adds a check that doubles hover latency in large files.
misconceptions: A plugin runs on every keystroke; its cost is the editor's cost.
curriculum.evidence: A latency measurement with the plugin enabled and disabled.
curriculum.artifact: A plugin with tests and a measured latency budget.

title: Webpack to Vite or Rspack migration with measured rollback

curriculum.learner_outcome: Migrate a build between bundlers with parity checks, median measurements and a rehearsed rollback.
curriculum.production_scenario: A migration ships and a dynamic import that used to split is inlined.
misconceptions: Byte-identical output is impossible; parity is a checklist.
curriculum.evidence: A parity script output and a measurement table with medians.
curriculum.artifact: A migration with both lines behind a switch and a rollback note.

title: The terminal, the shell and command execution

curriculum.learner_outcome: Distinguish the terminal, Bash and child commands using observable process behavior.
curriculum.production_scenario: A newcomer mistakes a printed prompt for text they must execute.
misconceptions: The terminal window and the shell program are not the same component.
curriculum.evidence: Identify the current shell and resolve three commands without installing software.
curriculum.artifact: An annotated first-session transcript explaining command resolution and exit status.

title: Paths, directories and working-directory state

curriculum.learner_outcome: Navigate a fixture tree using absolute and relative paths without losing context.
curriculum.production_scenario: A support engineer needs a log in a nested directory with spaces.
misconceptions: A relative path is interpreted from the current directory, not the script's location.
curriculum.evidence: Reach the same fixture by two paths and explain each component.
curriculum.artifact: A directory map and a repeatable navigation transcript.

title: Inspecting, copying and moving files deliberately

curriculum.learner_outcome: Manipulate fixture files while predicting source, destination and overwrite behavior.
curriculum.production_scenario: A release folder contains similarly named files and an existing backup.
misconceptions: Moving or copying with an existing destination can change the resulting path.
curriculum.evidence: Copy and rename fixture files and verify resulting contents and names.
curriculum.artifact: A before/after inventory with commands restricted to the lab directory.

title: Quoting, expansion and filename boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Preserve literal data and argument boundaries when filenames contain spaces or glob characters.
curriculum.production_scenario: A file named quarterly report is accidentally passed as two operands.
misconceptions: Double quoting still permits parameter and command substitution, unlike single quoting.
curriculum.evidence: Print argument counts for quoted and unquoted inputs including literal glob characters.
curriculum.artifact: An argument-boundary transcript with explanations for each observed expansion.

title: Finding trustworthy command documentation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Choose builtin help, manual pages or GNU documentation for the exact command environment.
curriculum.production_scenario: Instructions for a different platform's command flags fail in a Linux lab.
misconceptions: A command name does not guarantee identical flags on GNU and BSD implementations.
curriculum.evidence: Resolve a builtin and external command then locate their applicable options.
curriculum.artifact: A documentation notebook recording tool versions and verified option meanings.

title: Standard streams, redirection and exit status

curriculum.learner_outcome: Separate command data, diagnostics and success status in a reproducible terminal workflow.
curriculum.production_scenario: A report generator mixes diagnostic errors into its machine-readable output.
misconceptions: Redirecting stdout alone does not capture stderr or prove the command succeeded.
curriculum.evidence: Capture output and errors separately from a deliberately failing fixture command.
curriculum.artifact: A stream-routing diagram and files demonstrating success and failure paths.

title: Pipelines and visible failure propagation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Compose commands while inspecting pipeline statuses and preserving useful diagnostics.
curriculum.production_scenario: A failed data reader is hidden because the final counting command succeeds.
misconceptions: Successful output from the final command does not prove every pipeline stage succeeded.
curriculum.evidence: Compare a failing pipeline's status with pipefail off and on.
curriculum.artifact: A pipeline transcript with per-stage statuses captured immediately.

title: Inspecting and counting large text safely

curriculum.learner_outcome: Sample and summarize text without confusing byte, line and record counts.
curriculum.production_scenario: A support ticket includes a long log with a missing final newline.
misconceptions: Line count and record count are not identical for every file format.
curriculum.evidence: Compare counts and boundary samples for complete and unterminated fixture logs.
curriculum.artifact: A log-inspection worksheet with explained counting discrepancies.

title: Finding files and matching text

curriculum.learner_outcome: Separate filename selection from content matching and state the pattern language used.
curriculum.production_scenario: A repository contains spaces in names and text with regex metacharacters.
misconceptions: A shell glob and a regular expression are interpreted by different programs.
curriculum.evidence: Find chosen files and compare literal and regex matches against fixtures.
curriculum.artifact: A search recipe with expected matches and no accidental filename splitting.

title: Sorting, selecting fields and summarizing records

curriculum.learner_outcome: Build a text summary while stating delimiter, locale and ordering assumptions.
curriculum.production_scenario: A daily access log needs counts by service from tab-separated records.
misconceptions: uniq groups adjacent repeats rather than all equal lines anywhere in a file.
curriculum.evidence: Explain different counts before and after sorting a shuffled fixture.
curriculum.artifact: A deterministic summary pipeline and its expected-output file.

title: Users, groups and permission bits

curriculum.learner_outcome: Explain file and directory access using owner, group and permission bits.
curriculum.production_scenario: A colleague can list a directory but cannot open a nested file.
misconceptions: Directory execute permission means traversal, not running a directory as a program.
curriculum.evidence: Predict access in a lab permission matrix and inspect the resulting modes.
curriculum.artifact: A permission worksheet with least-privilege changes to owned fixtures.

title: Processes, jobs and signals

curriculum.learner_outcome: Inspect and stop a lab child process while distinguishing shell jobs from system processes.
curriculum.production_scenario: A long-running command holds the terminal and must be stopped cleanly.
misconceptions: A shell job number and a process ID are different identifiers.
curriculum.evidence: Start a harmless sleep process, inspect it and terminate only that recorded child.
curriculum.artifact: A process lifecycle transcript showing jobs, PID and termination status.

title: Environment variables, PATH and startup files

curriculum.learner_outcome: Explain variable inheritance and command lookup without changing global machine settings.
curriculum.production_scenario: A command works interactively but is missing in a scheduled shell.
misconceptions: A local shell variable is not automatically exported to child processes.
curriculum.evidence: Compare child environments and resolve a fixture command under a temporary PATH.
curriculum.artifact: An environment-difference report with a local reproducibility recipe.

title: Disk usage, links and space investigation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Investigate apparent disk usage while distinguishing filesystem capacity from directory totals.
curriculum.production_scenario: An operator sees different totals from directory usage and filesystem free-space reports.
misconceptions: du and df answer different questions and need not show equal totals.
curriculum.evidence: Compare fixture logical sizes, allocated usage and filesystem capacity outputs.
curriculum.artifact: A disk-investigation transcript with explanations and no system cleanup commands.

title: Archiving, listing and verifying fixture data

curriculum.learner_outcome: Create and inspect an archive and validate contents before extracting into an empty lab directory.
curriculum.production_scenario: A handoff archive must preserve a small project without surprising destination paths.
misconceptions: An archive filename or extension does not establish safe member paths or integrity.
curriculum.evidence: List members, extract owned fixtures into a fresh directory and compare checksums.
curriculum.artifact: A verified fixture archive with a manifest and inspection transcript.

title: Investigating a service incident from local logs

curriculum.learner_outcome: Form and test a service-failure hypothesis using a supplied log and process snapshot.
curriculum.production_scenario: A fixture service has intermittent failures but aggregate request volume looks normal.
misconceptions: A temporal correlation in logs does not by itself prove causation.
curriculum.evidence: Locate the failure interval and compare two plausible explanations against fixtures.
curriculum.artifact: An incident note linking every claim to a command and observed output.

title: A repeatable terminal operations investigation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Combine terminal skills into an auditable investigation that another learner can reproduce.
curriculum.production_scenario: A teammate needs a portable diagnosis of a failing fixture application.
misconceptions: A successful one-off command is not necessarily a reproducible workflow.
curriculum.evidence: Reproduce the diagnosis from a fresh fixture copy using only recorded commands.
curriculum.artifact: A terminal investigation notebook with inputs, outputs and remaining uncertainties.

title: Linux Bash capstone: diagnose and hand off

curriculum.learner_outcome: Diagnose a supplied filesystem and log problem and hand off verifiable evidence.
curriculum.production_scenario: A simulated release bundle has incorrect paths, permissions and a suspicious log interval.
misconceptions: Fixing the visible symptom does not demonstrate the underlying cause was understood.
curriculum.evidence: Identify each injected defect and show a fresh verification after proposed changes.
curriculum.artifact: A final diagnosis bundle containing evidence, minimal repairs and a handoff note.

title: Scripts, interpreters and a command-line contract

curriculum.learner_outcome: Write a Bash entry point with explicit inputs, outputs and interpreter assumptions.
curriculum.production_scenario: An automation script runs differently when invoked by sh and by Bash.
misconceptions: A .sh extension does not select the interpreter or make a file executable.
curriculum.evidence: Invoke a fixture script through Bash and as an executable and explain the requirements.
curriculum.artifact: A script README and a minimal CLI with documented exit behavior.

title: Variables, parameter expansion and safe defaults

curriculum.learner_outcome: Use quoted variables and parameter expansion to define missing and empty input behavior.
curriculum.production_scenario: An automation receives an empty output-directory setting from its environment.
misconceptions: Unset and empty are not interchangeable for every parameter-expansion operator.
curriculum.evidence: Exercise unset, empty, spaced and ordinary values and compare outputs.
curriculum.artifact: A configuration fixture script with an explicit input-case table.

title: Arguments, quoted arrays and option boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Forward arguments without splitting values or interpreting filenames as options.
curriculum.production_scenario: A batch tool receives a filename containing spaces and a leading hyphen.
misconceptions: Reconstructing arguments as one string does not preserve their original boundaries.
curriculum.evidence: Pass empty, spaced and leading-hyphen arguments through a wrapper unchanged.
curriculum.artifact: An argument-preserving wrapper and a reproducible boundary test transcript.

title: Exit codes, conditionals and explicit error paths

curriculum.learner_outcome: Branch on command status while separating expected absence from operational failure.
curriculum.production_scenario: A lookup script treats a missing record and an unreadable input as the same result.
misconceptions: Nonzero status is not always an exceptional failure that should abort the script.
curriculum.evidence: Exercise successful lookup, no match and invalid input with distinct outcomes.
curriculum.artifact: A small lookup CLI with documented status and diagnostic contracts.

title: Loops and record-safe input processing

curriculum.learner_outcome: Process line records without accidental splitting or losing the final unterminated record.
curriculum.production_scenario: A file list includes blank lines, backslashes and a final line without newline.
misconceptions: Looping over command-substitution output does not preserve arbitrary line records.
curriculum.evidence: Process the supplied edge-case input and compare exact recorded values.
curriculum.artifact: A record-reading function and fixtures for empty and unterminated inputs.

title: Functions, local scope and reusable commands

curriculum.learner_outcome: Extract reusable Bash functions with explicit arguments, scope and status contracts.
curriculum.production_scenario: A helper modifies a caller's variable and corrupts a later report.
misconceptions: A function's printed text and numeric exit status are separate output channels.
curriculum.evidence: Call a helper repeatedly and prove caller variables and data remain predictable.
curriculum.artifact: A small function library with interface examples and scope checks.

title: Arrays and command construction without eval

curriculum.learner_outcome: Construct argument vectors with Bash arrays instead of evaluating assembled command text.
curriculum.production_scenario: A wrapper needs optional flags and filenames containing punctuation or spaces.
misconceptions: Joining arguments into a string and evaluating it is not equivalent to an argument vector.
curriculum.evidence: Print each constructed argument and preserve empty and literal metacharacter values.
curriculum.artifact: An array-based command builder with an exact argument-vector fixture.

title: Parsing flags and validating a script interface

curriculum.learner_outcome: Parse short options and validate required operands before performing side effects.
curriculum.production_scenario: A scheduled report is launched with an unknown flag and a missing input file.
misconceptions: Parsing a flag does not validate that its value is usable.
curriculum.evidence: Test valid options, unknown flags, missing values and the end-of-options marker.
curriculum.artifact: A CLI parser with a usage message and acceptance-case table.

title: Text transformations with explicit record formats

curriculum.learner_outcome: Choose Bash or a text-processing tool based on the input's actual record grammar.
curriculum.production_scenario: A report consumes tab-separated fixture records with missing optional fields.
misconceptions: Splitting arbitrary CSV on commas does not implement CSV quoting rules.
curriculum.evidence: Validate field counts and reject malformed rows with useful diagnostics.
curriculum.artifact: A TSV summary tool with valid and malformed input fixtures.

title: Failure propagation and the limits of strict mode

curriculum.learner_outcome: Use explicit checks where errexit, pipelines or substitutions can hide failures.
curriculum.production_scenario: A backup automation reports success after a failed pipeline stage.
misconceptions: set -e is not a universal exception system and behaves differently inside conditionals.
curriculum.evidence: Demonstrate a masked failure then repair it with an explicit checked contract.
curriculum.artifact: An error-propagation table and a script that preserves the original failure code.

title: Temporary workspaces, traps and cleanup

curriculum.learner_outcome: Scope temporary artifacts and cleanup handlers to resources created by the script.
curriculum.production_scenario: An interrupted transformation leaves temporary output files beside a shared report.
misconceptions: Predictable temporary names and broad cleanup globs are unsafe ownership models.
curriculum.evidence: Interrupt a fixture run and verify its owned workspace is cleaned without masking status.
curriculum.artifact: A cleanup helper with success, failure and interruption transcripts.

title: Publishing output only after successful validation

curriculum.learner_outcome: Prevent partial reports by validating staged output before an atomic local rename.
curriculum.production_scenario: A scheduled reader opens a report while the writer is still producing it.
misconceptions: Writing directly to the final path exposes partial content despite eventual success.
curriculum.evidence: Fail generation halfway and verify the previous complete output remains readable.
curriculum.artifact: A staged report publisher with failure injection and old-output preservation tests.

title: Repeatable automation and explicit checkpoints

curriculum.learner_outcome: Make reruns converge on the intended result without duplicating effects.
curriculum.production_scenario: A batch job restarts after publishing half its requested fixture reports.
misconceptions: Retrying an arbitrary command is not always safe or idempotent.
curriculum.evidence: Run the automation twice and resume a partial run while comparing final manifests.
curriculum.artifact: A resumable fixture processor with repeated-run evidence and checkpoint rules.

title: Debugging and testing Bash behavior

curriculum.learner_outcome: Test script behavior at its CLI boundary and use tracing without leaking sensitive inputs.
curriculum.production_scenario: A script works for one filename but fails on empty and spaced operands.
misconceptions: Syntax checking cannot prove runtime behavior or correct argument handling.
curriculum.evidence: Run a matrix of exit status, stdout, stderr and filesystem assertions.
curriculum.artifact: A Bash test harness with deterministic fixtures and a documented debugging method.

title: Linux environments and Bash portability boundaries

curriculum.learner_outcome: Declare Bash and GNU dependencies and detect unsupported execution environments clearly.
curriculum.production_scenario: A script uses Bash arrays and GNU flags but is launched on an incompatible shell.
misconceptions: Bash availability does not imply all external tools implement GNU options.
curriculum.evidence: Check declared prerequisites and compare deterministic output under controlled locale.
curriculum.artifact: An environment contract and clear preflight failure cases.

title: Bounded background work and child status collection

curriculum.learner_outcome: Run bounded parallel fixture work while collecting each child result and cleaning owned processes.
curriculum.production_scenario: A batch script starts hundreds of workers and ignores failures from early children.
misconceptions: The status of the final wait is not automatically an aggregate of every child result.
curriculum.evidence: Limit active workers and inject one failure while accounting for every child.
curriculum.artifact: A bounded worker driver with per-item outcomes and interruption cleanup evidence.

title: Reliable report automation from untrusted filenames

curriculum.learner_outcome: Integrate input validation, argument safety and reliable publication into a report workflow.
curriculum.production_scenario: A teammate schedules a report against fixture files with deliberately awkward names.
misconceptions: A happy-path demonstration alone does not establish reliability for scheduled automation.
curriculum.evidence: Run normal, malformed-input, interrupted and repeated cases with exact expected outcomes.
curriculum.artifact: A report automation package containing implementation, fixtures and test results.

title: Bash Scripting capstone: a tested automation tool

curriculum.learner_outcome: Deliver a documented automation tool whose failure and recovery behavior is demonstrated.
curriculum.production_scenario: A small team needs a maintainable batch tool with predictable operational behavior.
misconceptions: Passing a few checks does not replace documenting unsupported inputs and assumptions.
curriculum.evidence: Demonstrate the tool from a clean lab and explain each deliberate failure result.
curriculum.artifact: A versioned script, README, fixture suite and a concise design reflection.
